video:video.video:title: Reply to Google reviews from WhatsApp
video:video.video:description: A physiotherapy practice receives a one-star review, adds the owner's factual context in WhatsApp and publishes a thoughtful public response.

video:video.video:title: Create Instagram posts and answer comments from WhatsApp
video:video.video:description: A restaurant sends a pasta photo in WhatsApp, reviews the caption, publishes the Instagram post and replies to routine comments in the owner's voice.

video:video.video:title: Confirm Instagram table bookings from WhatsApp
video:video.video:description: A guest requests a table for four tomorrow at 1pm in Instagram DMs. The owner checks the request and confirms it in WhatsApp, then the guest receives a confirmation and a later reminder.

video:video.video:title: Review weekly content insights and brand enquiries from WhatsApp
video:video.video:description: A creator receives a weekly WhatsApp insight on a previous tutorial and a suggestion for the next post. When a cosmetics brand asks about paid work, the creator requests the useful details before deciding.

video:video.video:title: Update your architecture portfolio and Instagram from WhatsApp
video:video.video:description: An architect sends three Project Amanara photos in WhatsApp, reviews the updated portfolio page and approves the Instagram post.

video:video.video:title: Turn a Christmas preorder post into an order notification
video:video.video:description: A wine shop shares a Christmas champagne preorder at 40 EUR per bottle from WhatsApp, publishes the Instagram post, answers a DM with an approved payment link and receives a six-bottle order notification.

video:video.video:title: Turn product photos into Instagram posts from WhatsApp
video:video.video:description: A jewelry photo on a distracting cloth gets a clearer presentation, a polished caption and an Instagram product post, all prepared from WhatsApp.

video:video.video:title: Capture after-hours salon enquiries on Instagram
video:video.video:description: In this demo, a bride messages Luna Hair at 23:47 after the salon has closed. BabyRock asks for the date, place, party size and time, then Rosalia briefs Mara. Mara offers a consultation on Thursday at 11, and Rosalia coordinates the next step with the customer.

video:video.video:title: Turn brand DMs into complete creator briefs
video:video.video:description: North & Co asks for two posts and paid-ad usage, but the request leaves out the details that shape the deal. BabyRock asks for the deadline, fee, usage period and contact. The creator sets the terms, reviews the proposed reply and decides what to send.

video:video.video:title: Take a day off while BabyRock handles routine messages
video:video.video:description: In this demo, Leo takes a day off. BabyRock answers routine questions about opening hours and card payment, while a table-for-eight request reaches him in WhatsApp with the 10pm closing time noted.

video:video.video:title: Reply to Instagram comments in your own voice
video:video.video:description: In this demo, a customer asks June Salon about Sunday on Instagram. BabyRock drafts a reply, June changes the formal tone, and the final wording appears under the comment in her voice.

video:video.video:title: Update your website and Google opening hours from WhatsApp
video:video.video:description: In this demo, Mesa Coffee usually opens at 9, but tomorrow it opens at 12. Luis asks in WhatsApp to update the website and Google profile. BabyRock prepares the change, Rosalia asks for approval, and Luis replies: 'Yes, publish it.'
